intent.goal: Make CLI commands consistent, well documented and free of user-facing defects.
intent.sourceQuote: Perform a comprehensive inspection of the `gh-aw` CLI tool to identify inconsistencies, typos, bugs, or documentation gaps.
intent.fullAcceptance: For each command, source-defined documentation and convention obligations plus independently verified real help, example validity and behavior must agree. No known required facet may be missing.
intent.partialAcceptance: A source-defined literal documentation obligation is attained exactly when its Contains/NotContains predicate, with the original source scope, holds on the immutable CLI documentation bytes.

activation.limitation: Current-source contract activated at the frozen cutoff, not workflow adoption. No application to earlier intent or conventions.

units.primary: percent of frozen literal documentation obligations attained
units.full: percent of independently accepted commands; unavailable without complete command/help/behavior evidence

eligibility.included: Every literal string Contains/NotContains assertion over text, compileSection or updateSection in these source-native tests.
eligibility.excluded: Engine-registry-dependent assertion remains inventoried and unavailable; not silently classified as clean.
eligibility.scope: compileSection and updateSection intentionally retain the original tests' suffix-of-document semantics, not a narrowed heading section.

rules.expression: "runs codemods, action version updates, and workflow compilation by default and uses `--no-fix` to skip all three steps"

rules.expression: "Outside a checkout, run `gh auth login --hostname <host>` to authenticate and set `GH_HOST=<host>` so repository diagnostics target the correct host."

rules.expression: "| `-h`, `--help` | Show help (`gh aw help [command]` for command-specific help) |\n| `-v`, `--verbose` | Enable verbose output showing detailed information |\n| `--banner` | Display ASCII logo banner with purple GitHub color theme |"

window.reason: Repository state, sampled at most once per daily workflow cadence; no overlapping flow totals.

antecedentExistence.reason: Commands, documentation and source-native convention checks can exist without the workflow. Historical source closure, actual adoption parent and contemporaneous native outputs have not been established in this bounded instrument.
antecedentExistence.classification: attainment-only at contract activation; no workflow-adoption comparison

invariants: No labels, finding counts, green runs, merged links or caller acceptance flags establish accepted commands.
Actor independent; partial conformance may improve without claiming whole CLI usability or causal contribution.
No monetary weights, subjective thresholds or keep/change bars.
Missing source or native evidence is null, never an all-clear.
Discovery lineage is retained losslessly, never scored as acceptance or contribution.
